title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe heat-map colormap to the Session 3 app
body:
## Problem
The Session 3 app draws temperature with a black, purple, orange, yellow ramp that some colour-blind users find hard to read.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A colormap that stays readable for common colour-blindness types, in light and dark mode, and a small colour bar with labelled values.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Readable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: an implicit solver without a step limit
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4. Students ask how to run the heat solver with big time steps; the explicit solver of Session 3 cannot.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: a heat pipe between the chips and the board edge
body:
## Problem
Session 3 spreads heat only through a uniform sheet; real laptops use heat pipes.

## Context
Roadmap Session 5.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app where a high-conductance strip is added to the board model and the peak rise is reported.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The roadmap checkpoint is met and shown in a figure
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: bare board against spreader, animated
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows two hot spots switching on and off on a bare board and on a board with a spreader; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Bare-board peak rise at least 3 times the spreader peak rise
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
